description: Fases 0-1 del roadmap: fundaciones + MVP del gestor de gastos (dashboard, transacciones, Quick Add, cuentas, categorías). Diseño y arquitectura de referencia en docs/ARQUITECTURA.md; modelo de datos en prisma/schema.prisma; tokens en src/app/globals.css. En el MVP la auth es un usuario demo (getSessionUser devuelve el usuario del seed); Supabase Auth llega en la fase 4.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js app with Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui and tooling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base Next.js project so every later story has a working build, typecheck and test runner.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js (App Router, latest stable) + React + TypeScript strict, src/ dir, import alias @/*; scaffold in place WITHOUT deleting existing files (docs/, prisma/, prisma.config.ts, claude-loop/, src/app/globals.css, src/lib/format.ts, src/features/dashboard/types.ts)
Tailwind CSS v4 + tw-animate-css; existing src/app/globals.css is kept as the global stylesheet

shadcn/ui initialised (components.json, src/lib/utils.ts with cn) and components added: button, card, dialog, sheet, command, dropdown-menu, input, label, select, tabs, badge, skeleton, separator, tooltip, popover, calendar, table, sonner, progress, scroll-area, toggle-group

Dependencies installed up front: lucide-react, recharts, @tanstack/react-query, @tanstack/react-table, nuqs, zod, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, date-fns, next-themes, sonner, prisma@7, @prisma/client@7, @prisma/adapter-pg, pg, dotenv, tsx; dev: vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, @testing-library/react, jsdom, @types/pg
Root layout loads Geist + Geist Mono via next/font, wraps app in ThemeProvider (class strategy), sets lang=es
package.json scripts: dev, build, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), lint, test (vitest run), db:migrate, db:seed
vitest.config.ts with @ alias and jsdom; one passing test for src/lib/format.ts (formatMoney negative uses U+2212, signed adds +, relativeChange returns null on 0)
.gitignore covers node_modules, .next, .env*, !.env.example, src/generated; .env.example documents DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL
Root AGENTS.md documenting folder conventions from docs/ARQUITECTURA.md §1
npm run typecheck and npm test pass
userStories.notes: Use npx create-next-app in a temp dir and copy over, or init manually, so existing files survive. Windows + Git Bash environment.

userStories.title: Prisma 7 client, initial migration and search index
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema applied and a shared Prisma client so services can query data.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server/db.ts exports a PrismaClient singleton (globalThis cache in dev) using @prisma/adapter-pg with DATABASE_URL, importing from @/generated/prisma/client
npx prisma validate passes; npx prisma generate outputs to src/generated/prisma
Initial migration created and applied (prisma migrate dev --name init) against the local Postgres in .env
Second migration enables pg_trgm and creates the GIN trigram index on transactions (description || notes) as noted in schema.prisma
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read .claude skill prisma-upgrade-v7 references (driver-adapters, prisma-config) if unsure. If .env is missing or DB unreachable, return a blocker — do not invent credentials.

userStories.title: Seed demo user with six months of realistic data
userStories.description: As a developer, I need realistic demo data so the dashboard and tables can be built and verified against real queries.
acceptanceCriteria: prisma/seed.ts is idempotent (deletes and recreates the demo user's data); runnable via npm run db:seed
Demo user (fixed uuid exported from src/server/demo-user.ts, baseCurrency EUR, locale es-ES)
Accounts: checking (BBVA), savings, credit card (Visa, creditLimit), cash
Two-level categories for income and expense with nature FIXED/VARIABLE and chart colors

~6 months of transactions ending today: monthly salary, rent, utilities, subscriptions, groceries, transport, leisure, plus monthly transfers checking→savings as two legs sharing transferGroupId; amountBase = amount (single currency)
Payees with defaultCategoryId; SYSTEM categorization rules (Netflix, Spotify, Uber, Mercadona, etc.)
Budgets (monthly) for 4 expense categories, one of them above 80 % this month; recurring rules for salary, rent, Netflix; one savings goal with contributions
Typecheck passes; seed runs without errors
userStories.notes: Use a seeded PRNG so data is deterministic.

userStories.title: Server HTTP helper, session user and React Query provider
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared plumbing for API routes and client data fetching.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server/auth.ts getSessionUser() returns the demo user (MVP) — single place to swap for Supabase later
src/server/http.ts handler() wraps Route Handlers: resolves user, parses body/query with a zod schema, maps ZodError→400, NotFoundError→404, unknown→500 JSON {error}
src/lib/query-keys.ts central query key factory
QueryProvider (client) with sensible staleTime, mounted in root layout alongside Toaster (sonner) and NuqsAdapter
Unit test for handler error mapping
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: App shell: sidebar, topbar and theme toggle
userStories.description: As a user, I want a calm, consistent shell so I can move between sections quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Route group src/app/(app) with layout: left sidebar (Resumen, Movimientos, Cuentas, Presupuestos, Metas, Ajustes with Lucide icons, active state) and account list; topbar with month switcher, search trigger showing ⌘K hint and primary 'Nueva' button showing N hint (buttons can be inert until QA-001)
Placeholder pages for each section; / redirects to /dashboard
Follows docs/ARQUITECTURA.md §3: hairline borders not shadows, no ALL-CAPS labels, sentence case, Geist
Light/dark toggle via next-themes; both themes legible
Below 768 px sidebar becomes a Sheet drawer; no horizontal scroll at 375 px
Visible keyboard focus on all nav items

userStories.title: Dashboard service and GET /api/v1/dashboard
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one endpoint that returns all dashboard aggregates as DashboardData.

src/app/api/v1/dashboard/route.ts uses handler(); ?month=YYYY-MM optional
useDashboard hook in src/features/dashboard/hooks

userStories.title: Switch demo data and formatting to Colombian pesos (COP, es-CO)
userStories.description: As a Colombian user, I want amounts in pesos and my real kind of accounts (Bancolombia, Nu) so the demo reflects how I manage money.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo user: baseCurrency COP, locale es-CO, timezone America/Bogota

Seed accounts replaced by: 'Bancolombia Ahorros' (SAVINGS, receives salary, main spending account), 'Nu Ahorros' (SAVINGS, linked to the savings goal, monthly transfer from Bancolombia), 'Efectivo' (CASH, monthly ATM withdrawal from Bancolombia), 'Tarjeta Nu' (CREDIT_CARD, realistic creditLimit e.g. 4.000.000 COP, paid monthly from Bancolombia). All in COP
All amounts realistic for Colombia (e.g. salary ~4.500.000, rent/arriendo ~1.400.000, budgets, goal target ~15.000.000 COP); amounts are whole pesos (no cents)

Colombian payees and SYSTEM categorization rules (e.g. Éxito, Carulla, D1, Ara, Rappi, Uber, DiDi, TransMilenio, Netflix, Spotify, Claro, EPM/Codensa/Vanti, Movistar, Farmatodo, Cine Colombia); category names adapted where needed (e.g. Arriendo, Servicios públicos)
Seed invariants still hold: idempotent, deterministic, transfer legs sum to zero, no negative Bancolombia/Efectivo running balance, one budget above 80 % this month

src/lib/format.ts: defaults currency COP / locale es-CO; currencies with no practical minor unit (COP, CLP, JPY…) format with 0 decimals; useGrouping 'always' so 4-digit amounts get a separator; tests updated (e.g. formatMoney(5555000) → '$ 5.555.000' style per es-CO Intl output, negative with U+2212)
Any hard-coded '€', 'EUR' or 'es-ES' in src/ (sidebar, shell, services, tests) replaced by the user's currency/locale
docs/ARQUITECTURA.md wireframe example amounts and account names updated to COP / Bancolombia / Nu
npm run db:seed runs twice cleanly; typecheck and tests pass
Verify in browser: sidebar shows the four accounts with COP balances; take a screenshot
userStories.notes: User request 2026-10-28. Supersedes DASH-002's note about useGrouping (that is handled here).

userStories.title: Dashboard page with KPI strip and sparklines
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my balance and this month's income, expenses and savings at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard/page.tsx (RSC) prefetches the dashboard query and renders DashboardView inside HydrationBoundary
KpiStrip: ONE bordered container split by vertical dividers into 4 segments (not 4 separate cards); Saldo total is larger (32px) and first
Each segment: label, value with tabular nums via <Money>, delta vs previous month colored by favourability (expense up = expense color), 1.5px sparkline in semantic color with ~8 % fill, no gradient
Skeleton loading state matching final shape; horizontal scroll-snap carousel below 768 px
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser with seeded data (light + dark + mobile) and take screenshots

userStories.title: Income vs expense chart with projection, and category donut
userStories.description: As a user, I want to compare income and expenses over time and see where my money goes.
acceptanceCriteria: CashflowChart: Recharts ComposedChart, income/expense bars + net line, ToggleGroup Mes/Trimestre/Año; current month shows projected values as dashed/hatched segment to month end
Custom tooltip with formatted money; axis text uses muted-foreground; colors from CSS tokens (works in dark mode)
CategoryDonut: top 5 categories + 'Otras', total in center, legend with amount and %
Empty state when no expenses this month with CTA 'Añadir movimiento'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser and take screenshots

userStories.title: Financial health panel and budget bars with pace marker
userStories.description: As a user, I want to know if I'm on track this month before I overspend.
acceptanceCriteria: FinancialHealthPanel: net cash flow, savings rate, fixed vs variable stacked bar, projected month-end net
BudgetProgress: bar with a thin vertical pace marker at daysElapsed/daysInMonth; warning color at >= alertThreshold, expense color at >= 100 %; shows spent/limit and %
Accessible: progressbar role with aria-valuenow and an aria-label that mentions the expected pace

userStories.title: Auto-categorization service
userStories.description: As a user, I want new transactions categorized automatically from the merchant or description.
acceptanceCriteria: src/server/services/categorization.service.ts: normalize() (lowercase, strip accents, strip suffixes like S.A., S.L., *1234, trailing digits) and suggest({payee, description}) following the order in docs §1
Supports CONTAINS, EQUALS, STARTS_WITH, REGEX (invalid regex is skipped, not thrown); increments hitCount/lastHitAt on apply
recordCorrection(): after 2 corrections of the same payee to the same category, create a LEARNED rule
GET /api/v1/categorize/suggest?payee=&description= returns {categoryId, ruleId, source} or null
Unit tests for normalize and rule ordering (pure matching function separated from DB)
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Transactions API with filters, cursor pagination and soft delete
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CRUD endpoints for transactions that the table and Quick Add use.
acceptanceCriteria: src/features/transactions/schemas.ts zod schemas shared with forms
GET /api/v1/transactions: filters dateFrom, dateTo, accountIds, categoryIds, tagIds, types, q (trigram/ILIKE search), cursor pagination, sort by date|amount
POST creates INCOME/EXPENSE (sign applied server-side from type) and TRANSFER (two legs, same transferGroupId, inside $transaction); auto-categorizes when categoryId absent
PATCH /[id] updates; DELETE /[id] sets deletedAt; POST /[id]/restore clears it (transfer legs move together)
All queries scoped by userId; accessing another user's id returns 404
Service-level tests for sign handling and transfer legs
Typecheck and tests pass
